parsed.name: AMI 430磁体电源程序控制器
parsed.description: AMI 430 是一款用于控制实验室磁体电源的程序控制器，常用于超导磁体系统中设定并斜坡磁场。它可驱动单个磁体电源，并在低温、量子器件和材料测量等实验中用于精确建立目标磁场。
parsed.description_en: The AMI 430 is a magnet power supply programmer used to control laboratory magnet power supplies, commonly in superconducting magnet systems, to set and ramp magnetic field. It is used to operate a single magnet supply and establish precise target fields in cryogenic, quantum-device, and materials measurement experiments.

actions.description_en: Set the target magnetic field of the magnet.
